offers_products.reason: Fuel cards, payment products, fleet management software and benefits accounts (HSA/FSA) are core offerings.

offers_services.reason: Benefits administration, COBRA, payment processing and fleet card services are main offerings, alongside the products.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Sells fleet cards, B2B payments and employer benefits to businesses; employees use accounts but employers choose.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Fleet operators, employers and businesses buy fuel cards, B2B payments and benefits administration.

recurring_revenue.reason: Fuel card transaction fees, payment volume and ongoing benefits administration generate repeat, continuing revenue from the same customers.

cyclical_demand.reason: Fuel, benefits administration and business payments are ongoing operating needs; spending is not easily postponed, though fuel volumes can dip.

big_ticket.reason: Fuel card transactions and benefits fees are small and frequent, not large one-off purchases.

people_delivered.reason: Revenue comes from payment network, card technology and software platforms, not mainly staff time.

large_customers.reason: Pitches fuel cards to small businesses and any fleet size; customers are mixed, many small and mid-sized.

asset_heavy.reason: Payments and software platform business using networks of third-party stations; needs technology investment, not heavy plants or fleets.

notes: Large customers answer is mixed: fleets range from small businesses to large enterprises and government.
